instructions:
LRD-preconditioned MCLMC on ill_cond_50 (kappa=1000 rotated Gaussian).
Pipeline: (1) oracle rank-40 COV decomposition via decompose_covariance_low_rank; (2) LRD IMM stored as .imm.npz sidecar; (3) mclmc_find_L_and_step_size with make_lrd_kernel binding the LowRankInverseMassMatrix.
k=40 (oracle rank; NUTS-pilot extraction was not needed because the exact covariance is available via ill_cond_50.COV).
IMM checkpoint at inverse_mass_matrix_path; load with np.load to skip re-extraction.
The emitted run-script uses mclmc_lrd_tuning (NUTS pilot path) for portability; the oracle-IMM path is for the catalog artifact only.
notes: Multi-seed hardening: seeds [11111, 22222, 33333] all PASS at ESS 1944-2031, ratios 450x-479x over diagonal (@statistician, 2026-06-09). Oracle COV decomposition (k=40) bypasses NUTS pilot for the calibration run. See attempted_configurations for per-seed gate evidence.

override.reason: Independent reproduction confirmed. LRD k=40 (oracle COV decomposition) achieves R-hat=1.0039, ESS=1993.3, ESS/grad=0.2492 vs diagonal ESS/grad=0.0006 (426x improvement).
